statistics.a_top_k_hit_rate: J-lens top-k readout contains the model's own top-1 token
statistics.b_excess_kurtosis: excess kurtosis of the readout distribution
statistics.c_top1_autocorrelation: top-1 token agreement across adjacent positions, against a position-shuffled null
statistics.d_effective_dimension: participation ratio of the Jacobian spectrum

rule: band = [onset of the kurtosis rise, onset of the sharp rise in next-token accuracy), intersected with the floors below, taking the longest surviving contiguous run
repairs_to_the_predecessor_rule: 1. absolute_floor - the predecessor rule ('the longest run at or above half the maximum') was scale-free by construction and had no absolute floor.
2. min_length - the predecessor rule had no minimum length and emitted a band of length 1 after condition (ii) was applied.
3. null_margin - every band layer must beat the matched-norm random-lens null. Adding this null is what actually lifted the predecessor's HB-002 blocker.
4. reject_right_censored - a band whose upper edge is the final layer is right-censored by the end of the network and is refused rather than reported.
human_intervention: none; the rule is automatic and its output is recorded whether or not a band is found
no_band_is_a_result: If no admissible band exists, that is reported. The rule may not be relaxed to produce one (§11).
